name: Filestash
short_desc: Universal file manager that works with S3, FTP, SFTP, WebDAV, SMB, and 20+ storage backends.
description: A storage-agnostic file manager that works with every storage protocol: FTP, SFTP, S3, SMB, WebDAV, IPFS, and many more. Plugin-driven architecture with support for file previewing (photos, videos, PDFs, office docs), AI-powered search and OCR, sharing links, user authentication, and a workflow engine for file automation. Single Go binary with minimal resource usage.
author: mickael-kerjean
